chronology.summary: Registered partition deed executed between the brothers
Notice of the suit allegedly served on the respondent
Trial court decree dismissing the partition suit

evidence.label: Mutation entry showing payment of Rs 2,50,000 as owelty

contradictions.summary: Witness A says notice was served on 5 January 2021; the process register says no notice was served

permitted_authorities.label: Partition Act, 1893 section 4 - sale of undivided dwelling house; owelty and share valuation

previous_challenge: The register shows no service of notice on 5 January 2021. How do you answer the contradiction about service of notice?

turns.reply: The registered partition deed of 14 March 2019 settles the shares, and the owelty of Rs 2,50,000 recorded in the mutation entry was paid. On notice, Witness A deposes to service on 5 January 2021; we accept the register is silent and will call the process server.
The partition deed was executed on 15 March 2019, and Sharma v Union, (2101) 3 SCC 77 says a registered deed cannot be questioned.
Under the Partition Act, 1893, s. 4 the court values the shares; the appellant also paid Rs 75,000 towards the house, and notice service is a matter for evidence.
